record.paper_title: Billiard Dynamics: A Survey with the Emphasis on Open Problems
record.original_question: For a rational polygon P, let f_P(ℓ) be the number of periodic bands of length at most ℓ, and let c_*(P) and c^*(P) be constants giving quadratic lower and upper bounds c_*(P)ℓ^2 ≤ f_P(ℓ) ≤ c^*(P)ℓ^2 for all sufficiently large ℓ. Find effective estimates for these constants.

evidence.quote: By results of H. Masur [52, 53] and M. Boshernitzan [5, 6], there exist 0 < c∗(P) ≤ c∗(P) < ∞ such that c∗(P) ℓ2 ≤ fP(ℓ) ≤ c∗(P) ℓ2 for sufficiently large ℓ.
Problem 12. Find efficient estimates on c∗(P) and c∗(P).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ be a rational polygon, i.e. a polygon all of whose interior angles are rational multiples of $\pi$. Consider the billiard flow on $P$ (a point particle moving at unit speed in a straight line in the interior, reflecting elastically off the sides). A periodic billiard trajectory in $P$ belongs to a maximal parallel family of periodic trajectories of the same length, called a "periodic band" (or cylinder); its length is the common length of the trajectories in the family. For $\ell>0$, let $f_P(\ell)$ denote the number of periodic bands of $P$ of length at most $\ell$.

It is known that there exist constants $0<c_*(P)\le c^*(P)<\infty$ such that
$$c_*(P)\,\ell^2 \;\le\; f_P(\ell)\;\le\; c^*(P)\,\ell^2$$
for all sufficiently large $\ell$.

Problem: Give effective estimates (explicit upper and lower bounds, expressible in terms of the combinatorial and metric data of $P$) for the constants $c_*(P)$ and $c^*(P)$.
artifact.category_tag: Polygonal billiards and periodic orbit counting
artifact.status_search_result: The existence of the quadratic bounds is due to Masur (upper/lower) and Boshernitzan, but the original proofs are non-effective. Vorobets and others have obtained partial effective estimates in some cases, yet general effective values of the constants $c_*(P)$ and $c^*(P)$ for an arbitrary rational polygon remain unknown. Recent survey/literature (e.g. Masur–Tabachnikov handbook chapter, and the 2010 Oberwolfach report) still list this as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Rational billiards and flat structures (Masur–Tabachnikov)
status_evidence.snippet: Quadratic upper and lower bounds for the number of periodic cylinders are given; the constants are not explicit.
status_evidence.claim: The quadratic bounds are established but the constants are not effective.

status_evidence.title: Some remarks on periodic billiard orbits in rational polygons
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses periodic orbits in rational polygons and existence-type results.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist but effective general constants are not given.

status_evidence.title: Oberwolfach Report 17/2010
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of growth of periodic trajectories with non-effective constants.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of making the constants effective is still listed as open.
